title: Radiomics and neural-network fusion separates HCC from cholangiocarcinoma on CT
summary: In 186 patients from two centers (111 HCC, 75 ICC), a fusion neural network combined a radiomics SVM, clinical predictors (cirrhosis, CA19-9) and deep learning on CT images. It reached an AUC of 0.99 in the internal validation set (n = 41) and 0.95 in the external validation set (n = 52), above single-modality models. The cohorts are small and retrospective, so the numbers are exploratory.
ai_technology: Fusion neural network combining a radiomics SVM, clinical logistic regression and hybrid neural networks on contrast-enhanced CT
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Chengdu Medical College

evidence.tested: Internal validation (n = 41) and external validation from a second center (n = 52).
evidence.unknown: Performance in larger and prospective cohorts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Distinguishes HCC from ICC on multiphase contrast-enhanced CT.
